equation_summary: RWKV-4 WKV keeps a THREE-part per-channel state (alpha, beta, eps) where eps is a running max-shift. At step t with current (k_t,v_t): tau=max(u+k_t, eps); wkv_t = (e^{eps-tau}*alpha + e^{u+k_t-tau}*v_t)/(e^{eps-tau}*beta + e^{u+k_t-tau}); then the state is re-stabilized: eps'=max(w+eps, k_t), alpha'=e^{w+eps-eps'}*alpha + e^{k_t-eps'}*v_t, beta'=e^{w+eps-eps'}*beta + e^{k_t-eps'}. w=-exp(w_raw) is a per-channel decay, u a per-channel bonus. This is a max-shifted normalized (numerator/denominator) vector state, NOT a raw additive K2 matrix state.
state_shape: per-channel 3-tuple of vectors (alpha numerator [C], beta denominator [C], eps max-shift [C]); state stored as [B,3,C]
gate_scope: channel (per-channel w decay and u bonus)
normalization: denominator-state (beta) with max-shift (eps) rescaling; division per step
